score_notes.retention: The stakes now climb the whole way. The playful phase (bendy fingers, wobbling queue) runs to 0:27.5. Then come the rule, the implication and the first real collapse in the textless break (kerb, arcade, queue fold). The ladder is bust -> kerb -> Colosseum -> concrete -> your house -> 8.2 billion hearts (human peak at 46%) -> white-out -> planet montage under one counter -> back to you for a same-unit race. The twist is a reversal, not the default: calcium returns where it vanished, so white ghost skeletons hang 1 m above the heaps. Every HUD number matches its picture. Remaining risks: calcium is a weaker premise than electrons or oxygen (PLAYBOOK 10C), and all on-screen text runs 148 wpm against the 103-131 band.
score_notes.reference: The citations were rechecked against the corpus files and every row now cites a device at the right timestamp. ELECTRONS @0:15 is a true analogue now (POV hands, harmless). NEUTRONS @0:37 is the human climax before the white-out, @0:52 is the same-unit second countdown that the return wins, and @1:09 is the returning particles doing something new that pays a plant. OXYGEN supplies the baseline-before-delta (@0:00-0:07), the mid-video meter plant (@0:28) and the ladder snapping back to the viewer (@0:35). Several rungs change mode (heart signal, ranking flip, closing distance) and carry exact computed numbers. Pacing self-report corrected.
